verdict.rationale: Helicone documents Sessions that group related requests (docs-5, docs-43) and dashboard tracking of usage and costs (docs-42). Custom properties appear in its rate-limit controls and webhook filters (docs-48, docs-10), and a user confirms Custom Properties exist but hold only a little metadata (comm-5). However, no evidence shows cost and usage actually being broken down by user, session, or feature through these properties. missing for 10: documented per-user/per-property cost attribution and reporting, a dedicated custom-properties/user-metrics doc, independent hands-on corroboration of cost segmentation.
